10k.note: 10-K describes commercial-stage operations centered on the Aurix System (FDA-cleared biodynamic hematogel for chronic wound care) and a US distribution agreement with Smith+Nephew. No active P1/P2/P3 drug development program disclosed.

website.note: Corporate site (nuotherapeutics.com DNS not resolvable; nuot.com is the operating domain). No /pipeline page; product page describes Aurix as the marketed product.

ctgov.note: Historical Aurix studies (e.g. NCT02352467 pressure ulcer; CMS CED chronic diabetic foot ulcer registry) are completed post-market device studies, not active P1/P2/P3 drug trials.

devices.name: Aurix System
devices.category: Biodynamic hematogel; autologous platelet/plasma-based wound therapy
devices.indication: Chronic wounds (diabetic foot ulcers, venous leg ulcers, pressure ulcers)
devices.status: FDA-cleared, marketed in US (private-label distribution via Smith+Nephew agreement signed March 31, 2025)

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Commercial-stage medical device company. Sole product Aurix is an FDA-cleared autologous wound-care device already on market; no active investigational P1/P2/P3 drug or device trials sponsored by Nuo. Prior Aurix studies are completed post-market device evaluations.
